collect._comment: Lighthouse CI's static-directory autodiscovery audits at most 5 URLs by default. That silently stopped covering the home page as soon as the sixth page was added, and with fourteen pages planned most of the site would never have been audited at all. 0 means no limit.

assertMatrix._comment: Deliberately non-indexable pages: the two not-found variants, the internal component gallery, and the enquiry confirmation. Lighthouse scores noindex as an SEO failure, so asserting the SEO category here would amount to requiring that these pages be indexable, which is the opposite of what they are for. Every other category still applies.
